recognize_zh: 這是周邊血液流式細胞圖：紅色族群位於 CD45 弱陽性/陰性、低側散射（SSC）的「母細胞區」，約占 44%，並呈 CD19+、CD10 強陽性、CD34+、HLA-DR+，而 CD20、CD13、CD117 陰性；這組免疫表型即為 B 淋巴母細胞白血病（B-ALL）。
features: CD45 vs SSC: red population (about 44%) in the dim-to-negative CD45, low SSC blast gate, distinct from granulocytes (green), monocytes (cyan), and lymphocytes (blue)
CD19 vs CD45: blasts are CD19 positive with dim CD45, separate from normal CD45-bright B cells
CD10 vs CD34 and HLA-DR vs CD34: blasts are uniformly CD10 bright, CD34 positive, and HLA-DR positive
CD10 vs CD20: blasts are CD20 negative, unlike mature CD20-positive B cells
CD13 vs CD117: blasts negative for CD117 and essentially negative for CD13, whereas granulocytes express CD13
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood shows an abnormal population (red) comprising approximately 43-44% of events, located in the dim-to-negative CD45, low side-scatter region. The population is positive for CD19, CD34, HLA-DR, and bright CD10 (with CD22 and CD58 reported), and negative for CD20, CD117, CD13, CD33, and surface immunoglobulin light chains. Normal granulocytes, monocytes, and CD45-bright lymphocytes, including mature CD20-positive B cells, serve as internal controls. This immunophenotype is consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia; cytogenetic and molecular studies are needed for risk classification.

ddx.vs: Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum from CD34+/CD10 bright to CD20+/CD10 dim with normal CD45 and CD58, rather than a discrete CD45-dim, uniform CD34+/CD10 bright/CD20-negative cluster.
AML blasts in the same CD45-dim gate would express myeloid markers such as CD13, CD33, CD117, or MPO, which are negative here.
Requires MPO positivity or monocytic differentiation in addition to strong B markers; absence of CD13/CD33/CD117 argues against it.
Burkitt cells are CD10+ and CD19+ but CD34 and TdT negative, CD20 and surface light chain positive, with bright CD45.
